fields.title: Article / latest-headline record
fields.description: Raw-passthrough dataset envelope. Every record carries _input/_source/_scrapedAt (and _error/_errorDetail on failures). Article-mode records (S1-html) carry headline/articleBody-style fields extracted from ld+json NewsArticle plus HTML body text. Latest-mode records (S2-rss) carry title/link-style fields from the RSS feed. Upstream ld+json is passed through close to verbatim, so extra fields beyond those listed here may also appear.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The exact input value (article URL, or 'latest') that produced this record.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: Which extraction strategy emitted this record (S1-html, S2-rss, or 'none' on error).

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was scraped.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Present only on failed extractions -- the error kind (e.g. not_found, http_4xx, blocked_or_transient).

_errorDetail.title: Error detail
_errorDetail.description: Free-form diagnostic detail, present only alongside _error.

headline.title: Headline
headline.description: Article headline, from the ld+json NewsArticle block (HTML entities unescaped). Article-mode only.

description.title: Description
description.description: Article-mode: short description/dek from the ld+json NewsArticle block. Latest-mode: short teaser text from the RSS item (not full article text).

articleBody.title: Article body
articleBody.description: Full article text, joined from div.detail-content paragraphs (excludes figcaption captions and related-news widget text). Article-mode only -- not present in the ld+json block itself.

author.title: Author
author.description: Article-mode: byline name from the ld+json Person author object. Latest-mode: author text from the RSS item.

publisher.title: Publisher
publisher.description: Publisher organization name from the ld+json Organization block. Article-mode only.

datePublished.title: Date published
datePublished.description: ISO 8601 publish date from the ld+json NewsArticle block. Article-mode only.

dateModified.title: Date modified
dateModified.description: ISO 8601 last-modified date from the ld+json NewsArticle block. Article-mode only.

image.title: Image
image.description: Lead image URL. Article-mode: from the ld+json image object. Latest-mode: from the RSS item's enclosure url attribute.

title.title: Title
title.description: Headline from the RSS item. Latest-mode only.

link.title: Link
link.description: Article URL from the RSS item. Latest-mode only.

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Key columns across both article and latest-headline records.
